summary.title: Sun 11-01: VanVleet IL->G; Melton add blocked by Yahoo IL rule
summary.headline: Lineup verified 15/15. No add today: any add now needs a drop, and none the tool checked helps.
summary.verdict: Down 4-5 with 2 games vs 3; P(win week 2) about 0.15. Melton (GSW) into the empty G was +21 pp, but Yahoo refused it (#845: VanVleet, now Q, can't stay in IL).
risks: VanVleet and Sheppard (Q) now count as active players: 14 for 13 spots, so a drop is due when either is cleared.
Yahoo's edit form still offers IL for Q players, but transactions are refused (#845).
rationale: - VanVleet IL->G: HOU is idle today and G was empty, so nothing is lost; it clears Yahoo's block for transactions.
- Only Sexton and Podziemski play today; both already start.
- Melton with a drop: Fears hurts, Sheppard frees no active spot, and Sexton plays tonight.

why_now.before: 10-31: you approved Shead into the open spot; Shalom added Shead at 02:09 ET, before any run could execute it.

changed.text: VanVleet and Sheppard went O -> Q overnight; Yahoo now blocks adds while a Q player is in IL (#845).
